headlines.title: 南方东英回应市场疑虑：预计两倍做多海力士维持两倍杠杆
headlines.summary: 近期，南方东英SK海力士每日杠杆（2x）产品因价格剧烈波动成为市场焦点。 截至7月30日，SK海力士较6月高点累计跌去49%，两倍做多海力士的产品净值累计回撤超过80%，规模从1300亿港元缩水约千亿港元。 在香港证监会上周发布新规后，本周一，南方东英发布公告，宣布自8月3日起，旗下挂钩SK海力士、三星电子、特斯拉、英伟达等12只热门海外个股的杠杆及反向产品，将全面切换至“灵活杠杆结构”。此举引发了投资者质疑，因为若管理人主动降低杠杆，假设后续SK海力士快速反弹，ETF净值修复的速度将明显变慢，高位买入的回本周期将会变长。

headlines.title_en: Southern East Ying responds to market concerns: Expected to maintain double leverage on 2x long SK Hynix
headlines.summary_en: Recently, CSOP SK Hynix Daily Leverage (2x) product became market focus due to sharp price swings. As of July 30, SK Hynix is down 49% from June high, 2x long product NAV has drawn down over 80%, size shrank from HK$130 billion by about HK$100 billion. After SFC issued new rules last week, on Monday CSOP announced that from August 3, its leveraged and inverse products linked to 12 popular overseas stocks including SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics, Tesla, Nvidia, will fully switch to a flexible leverage structure. This drew investor questions, as if manager actively lowers leverage, assuming SK Hynix rebounds quickly later, ETF NAV recovery pace would slow markedly, and payback period for high-entry buyers would lengthen.

headlines.title: China’s manufacturing sector falters in July as growth momentum cools
headlines.summary:
China’s factory activity has slipped into contraction in July, ending a four-month growth streak as weaker new orders and persistent demand challenges highlight the need for further policy support from Beijing, analysts said.
The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) fell to 49.2 in July, down from 50.3 in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Friday. The reading fell short of the 50.11 projection from economists polled by the financial data...

headlines.title_en: Xi Jinping Emphasizes at 27th Collective Study Session of the CPC Central Politburo: Strengthen Political Guidance, Deepen Innovative Development, and Advance National Defense and Military Modernization with High Quality
headlines.summary_en: According to Xinhua, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held the 27th group study session on the afternoon of July 30 on advancing national defense and military modernization with high quality. General Secretary Xi Jinping stressed during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, adhere to guidance of socialism with Chinese characteristics for a new era, deeply implement the Party's thinking on strengthening the military for a new era, strengthen political leadership, deepen innovative development, advance defense and military modernization with high quality, achieve the centenary goal of building the people's military on schedule, push for decisive progress in basically realizing defense and military modernization, and provide strong strategic support for comprehensively building a strong country and national rejuvenation through Chinese modernization.

headlines.title: 工信部：上半年规模以上电子信息制造业增加值同比增长14.8%
headlines.summary: 工信部发布数据，上半年，规模以上电子信息制造业增加值同比增长14.8%，增速分别比同期工业、高技术制造业高9.4个和高1.5个百分点。6月份，规模以上电子信息制造业增加值同比增长15.7%。主要产品中，工业机器人产量53.8万套，同比增长28.0%；新能源汽车产量739.9万辆，同比增长6.0%；集成电路产量2798亿块，同比增长23.1%。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Value-Added Output of Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry Above Designated Size Up 14.8% Year-on-Year in H1
headlines.summary_en: MIIT data: In H1, value added of electronics and information manufacturing above designated size rose 14.8% YoY, 9.4 and 1.5 percentage points faster than industry and high-tech manufacturing respectively. In June, value added rose 15.7% YoY. Among major products, industrial robot output 538,000 sets, up 28.0%; NEV output 7.399 million units, up 6.0%; integrated circuit output 279.8 billion units, up 23.1%.

headlines.title_en: Combined Turnover of Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing Markets Exceeds 2.5 Trillion Yuan, Up 177.9 Billion Yuan Compared to This Time Yesterday

headlines.title: 研报掘金丨中信建投：予中国铀业“买入”评级，有望开启高成长新周期
headlines.summary: 中信建投证券研报指出，双碳目标、能源安全、AI热潮之下，全球核能复苏带动铀需求稳中有增，叠加供给刚性、库存持续去化，天然铀价格有望长牛。中国铀业作为天然铀保障供应的国家队、主力军，境内外资源控制量丰富，同时掌握以CO?+O?地浸采铀技术为代表的复杂砂岩型铀矿地浸采铀技术体系，伴随4个天然铀募投项目的建成投产，以及海外罗辛铀矿、亚兰格海因里希铀矿、埃坦戈铀矿产能释放，公司有望开启高成长新周期。考虑到公司在天然铀行业地位和较高的成长性，给予公司“买入”评级。

headlines.title_en: Research Report Pick丨CITIC Construction Investment: Initiates China Uranium with 'Buy' Rating, Poised for New High-Growth Cycle
headlines.summary_en: CSC Financial research note: Under dual carbon targets, energy security, and AI boom, global nuclear energy recovery drives steady uranium demand growth, coupled with rigid supply and continued inventory drawdown, natural uranium prices may see a long bull market. China Uranium, as the national team and main force for natural uranium supply assurance, has abundant domestic and overseas resource control, while mastering complex sandstone uranium in-situ leaching technology systems represented by CO2+O2 leaching, with four natural uranium fundraising projects completed and put into operation, plus overseas Rössing, Langer Heinrich, Etango uranium mine capacity release, the company is expected to start a new high-growth cycle. Given its position in natural uranium industry and high growth, initiate with Buy rating.

headlines.title: 国内汽、柴油价格7月31日起每吨分别上调685元、655元
headlines.summary: 7月17日国内成品油价格调整以来，国际市场原油价格剧烈震荡，前几日连续大幅上涨后回落，近日又再度冲高，本次调价的前10个工作日平均价格高于上次调价前10个工作日平均价格。根据国际市场油价变化情况，自7月31日24时起，国内汽、柴油（标准品）价格每吨分别上调685元、655元。(发改委)

headlines.title_en: Domestic Gasoline and Diesel Prices to Rise 685 Yuan and 655 Yuan per Ton from July 31
headlines.summary_en: Since the domestic refined oil price adjustment on July 17, international crude oil prices have fluctuated sharply, falling after several days of big gains, then surging again recently. The average price in the 10 working days before this adjustment is higher than the previous 10 working days average. Based on international oil price changes, from 24:00 July 31, domestic gasoline and diesel (standard) prices rise 685 yuan and 655 yuan per tonne respectively. (NDRC)
